name: Ibidi mu-Plate 82426 24 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes: ibidi mu-Plate 24 Well ibiTreat, catalogue number 82426: 24 round wells in a 4 x 6 array, black polymer walls with a flat ibidi Polymer Coverslip bottom, tissue-culture treated (ibiTreat, hydrophilic), sterilized, supplied with a lid. The vendor styles the product 'ibidi mu-Plate 24 Well' with a lowercase-mu and lowercase vendor name; the registry 'name' uses an ASCII rendering ('Ibidi mu-Plate 82426 24 well') because every other dropdown entry is ASCII and title-cased. EVERY DIMENSION IN THIS FILE IS READ FROM ONE DOCUMENT: the ibidi 'mu-Plate 24 Well Instruction Manual', Version 1.2, dated 2025-02-20, published at https://ibidi.com/img/cms/products/labware/plates/P_824XX_Plate_24well/IN_8242X_24well.pdf and staged at Ramona under logs/add-labware/ibidi-82426/. That manual states on its first page that it applies to 82426 (ibiTreat) and 82421 (Uncoated), so this file registers the part that was requested and 82421 is the SAME MOULD with a different surface treatment - the geometry here is valid for it too. The glass-bottom mu-Plate 24 Well, 82427, is a DIFFERENT document (IN_82427_24well_glass.pdf) and is NOT covered by these numbers. From the manual's 'Specifications (mm)' table: length 127.5 +/- 0.2, width 85.5 +/- 0.2, height without lid 20.0 +/- 0.4 (height WITH lid is 22.4 +/- 0.4 and is NOT used, because z_reference is the top surface of the plate), well-to-well distance 18.9 +/- 0.1. From its 'Single Well Dimensions' table: single well diameter 14.0 +/- 0.1, single well depth 19.0 +/- 0.2, volume 1 mL per well, growth area 1.54 cm2, coating area 4.4 cm2. The wells are straight-walled cylinders, so the 14.0 mm diameter is both the top diameter (this registry's convention) and the growth-surface diameter; cross-check: pi x (14.0/2)^2 = 1.539 cm2, which reproduces the stated 1.54 cm2 growth area exactly. A1 OFFSETS ARE PUBLISHED, NOT DERIVED: the dimensioned plan view on page 1 of the manual carries 16.5 mm from the left edge to the A1 column centre and 14.4 mm from the top edge to the A1 row centre, with A1 at the top-left corner (the chamfered corner), rows A-D top to bottom and columns 1-6 left to right. Both close arithmetically against the footprint: 16.5 + 5 x 18.9 + 16.5 = 127.5 and 14.4 + 3 x 18.9 + 14.4 = 85.5, so the grid is exactly centred in both axes and the printed table and drawing agree with each other. BOTTOM: the bottom is an ibidi Polymer Coverslip, No. 1.5 thickness, 0.18 mm (180 um), refractive index 1.52 at 589 nm, Abbe number 56 - NOT glass, and not detachable. Section A-A on page 2 dimensions the underside as 0.82 mm 'well clearance' (the air gap between the plate's ground plane and the underside of the coverslip) plus the 0.18 mm coverslip, totalling the 1.0 +/- 0.1 mm 'focal offset' the manual tabulates - i.e. the well floor sits 1.0 mm above the surface the plate rests on. THAT 1.0 mm, NOT A CONVENTIONAL BOTTOM THICKNESS, IS THE WORKING-DISTANCE NUMBER FOR THIS PLATE, and only 0.18 mm of it is solid material. Section A-A closes with the rest of the file: 19.0 mm well depth + 1.0 mm focal offset = the 20.0 mm plate height. CONTRADICTION WITH DISTRIBUTOR LISTINGS: ibidi's own catalogue page and several distributors quote the 'mu-Plate 24 Well Black' family as 16.3 mm well diameter, 18.6 mm well depth, 20.1 mm height without lid and 1.2 mm well clearance. Those figures belong to an older/other mould of the same product line; the Version 1.2 manual that names 82426 explicitly gives 14.0 / 19.0 / 20.0 / 0.82, and that manual is what this file follows. If a plate in hand measures ~16.3 mm wells, it is not the mould this file describes. The manual states the plate meets ANSI/SLAS 1-2004, 2-2004, 3-2004 and 4-2004; note its footprint of 127.5 x 85.5 mm is ibidi's printed value and differs slightly from the ANSI/SLAS 1-2004 nominal 127.76 x 85.48 mm - ibidi's numbers are used here. Material is a polymer (not polystyrene-standard optical grade); the plate is single-use, not autoclavable, temperature-stable to 80 C. Dimensions in metres.
